claims.description: The redacted 59-issue export was reviewed in full and retained as the source inventory for the classification.
The source cluster summary was reviewed and its Resend counts were independently recomputed as 192 + 168 + 10 + 6 = 376.
Every major cluster is classified as a product defect, staging/test noise, provider/config issue, duplicate, or needing deeper evidence, with the shared cause recorded.
The eleven follow-up records consolidate shared root causes rather than duplicating all 59 Sentry issues; WI-2756 Related Items was read back with exactly WI-2757 through WI-2767.
The follow-up evidence table cites each live record, its Sentry issue evidence from Found In, and its root-cause record, including WI-2766's verified acceptance-criteria refinement.
No Sentry issue was resolved or archived; the artifact records only a staged resolution plan gated on verified fixes or noise reclassification.
